metadata.name: Marine Salp Biochemical Measurements – IOS20210060
metadata.description: Dataset of 107 Salpa aspera samples collected during the IOS20210060 expedition. Each record provides event identifiers, date/time, vessel, station, gear, depth, location, latitude, longitude, taxonomic details, and measured biochemical properties (carbon, nitrogen, hydrogen, ash and dry mass, elemental ratios such as C/N, C/H, H/C, and summary values). The data span from 2004‑04‑12 to 2021‑05‑27 and cover a latitudinal range of –69° to +51° and a longitudinal range of –158° to +179°.
